corrections: Do not use mega-prompt -> wait -> final audit as the default complex-work method.
Do not follow Work's framing when it drifts from the approved direction.
Do not let Work autonomously replan after a rejected proposal.
decisions: For complex or risky delegation, prompt precision does not replace active supervision.
The supervisor sets stop points and asks Work for plan/design/candidate code or diff/evidence before authorizing material application.
Alberto may relay messages but is not responsible for deciding gates or evidence needs.
If Work is rejected or deviates, Work stops and returns to the supervisor; the supervisor replans from the last valid point.
Material ambiguity about Alberto's intent is escalated to Alberto instead of being invented or delegated to Work.
